card.name: Small words inside dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, without, on, of, be, or a number gap, in the middle of dosing, administration or treatment instructions. The next word is often a medication or dosing term.

modes.label: Linking word before medication or dose
modes.description: The word the, of or be sits right before a drug or dose noun in a treatment sentence.
modes.example: usually lessen with continued use of<< the>> medication.

modes.label: Administration how-to wording
modes.description: A preposition in instructions for taking or mixing a dose, such as swallowing or sprinkling on food.
modes.example: the capsule may be opened and the entire contents sprinkled<< on>> applesauce.
